author: cybrshdw
body:
Hi! My friends username is WitchCraftMC, he has been ban for around 8 months, and we both think he has progressed enough to be unbanned. He was at a friends house who had hacks on his machine, and whilst he was in the restroom, his friend took over controls, turned on kill aura, then got banned. So, he didn't actually do it, his Ex-Friend did. He was a great player with lots of play time, we also created a YouTube series, where you can see, no hacks. Thanks, Cybrshdw.

Please Take My Word, Cheers!
